text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall from about 99,454 to 110,138, but the path included swings; I should judge progress over time, not react to one month’s return.","I sold Stock B at a substantial loss and added to A and C; next time I’ll decide trades using a written rationale rather than recent price moves or the urge to recover losses.","After making those trades, I made no further changes for several periods, so I’ll review holdings regularly but trade only when my plan or the investment case gives me a clear reason."]}
